root_cause_sequence.cause: The valid Debian bubblewrap 0.12.0 binary did not match the integrity digest embedded in Codex 0.153.4.

root_cause_sequence.result: Digest verification passed; execution denied before bubblewrap startup
root_cause_sequence.cause: A bwrap binary placed beside Codex is treated as bundled. Codex verifies it and invokes it through /proc/self/fd/N, while the reviewed AppArmor policy intentionally permits only an exact executable path transition.
root_cause_sequence.stderr_summary: failed to exec bundled bubblewrap via /proc/self/fd/3: Operation not permitted

official_release_artifact.verification: GitHub release API digest, downloaded archive digest, archive member digest, and Codex embedded expected digest all match.

selected_design.reason: Keep the verified bwrap on PATH but outside Codex's bundled-resource candidate locations, so execution uses the exact real path rather than a broad /proc fd path.
selected_design.rejected_alternative: Do not add a /proc/*/fd/* execute transition because it would authorize a broader class of fd-backed executables than required.

candidate.build_checks: Passed archive and executable digests, executable mode and PATH resolution, Codex/Node/npm/uv versions, Python 3.11.15, 69-package dependency baseline, pip check, and absence of SDD tools.

apparmor_policy.loaded_kernel_copy: STALE; administrator reload required after this file update

security_invariants.runtime_probe_controls: UID/GID 1007:1007, cap-drop ALL, no-new-privileges, read-only root, network none, fixed seccomp, task AppArmor profile, private tmpfs.

cleanup_audit.original_experiment_containers: All three remain running on sha256:f59cdcb1f1be58c9ee0becf4eff13ea4979aea617aa5bf2c4619ae2c13c4adfa with restart_count 0.

next_action: Reload the updated AppArmor policy, then rerun the full sandbox startup, allowed-write, denied-write, and loopback-isolation probe against the immutable candidate image.
